summary: Chartbrew is an open-source web application that connects directly to various data sources and APIs to render visual charts and dashboards. It provides a centralised interface for querying backend stores and presenting the resulting metrics clearly without requiring custom frontend code.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers and analysts who need to quickly spin up internal dashboards using existing relational databases or web services.
watchOut: You should consider how exposing direct database connections to a self-hosted business intelligence tool impacts your security perimeter and network architecture.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged with Docker, it typically requires a persistent storage volume for configuration data and a reverse proxy to handle HTTPS termination.
